segments.text: Ludwig van Beethoven
Ludwig van Beethoven, starting in his late twenties
Slowly began to lose his hearing
For a musician, no suffering could have been greater
Yet silence did not stop the music inside him
Deafness drove him toward despair
Yet he continued to compose music of extraordinary depth
In 1824, his final completed symphony
The ninth received its first performance
It was a grand composition
Using a choir to sing Schiller's poem
Ode to Joy
On the night of the first performance
Beethoven stood on the stage
He faced the podium
But he could no longer hear any sound
After the final note, applause filled the hall
Yet he stood with his back turned, not noticing
One of the soloists gently touched his arm
And made him turn around before him
The audience was on its feet, applauding
Silence did not lock him inside
Through silence he continued to reach toward humanity
The knife is a testament to the creativity
Beethoven
Sustained through profound suffering
